---
name: Design system change
about: Propose Campus Blue tokens, primitives, shells, or interaction patterns
title: "[Design system] "
labels: design-system, frontend
---

## User/role problem

Which student, teacher or admin workflow is inconsistent or inaccessible?

## Existing component or token

Link the current page/component/token and explain why reuse is insufficient.

## Proposed pattern

Describe anatomy, variants, states and responsive behavior. Avoid page-specific one-off APIs.

## Accessibility

Keyboard flow, focus state, contrast, reduced motion and screen-reader expectations.

## Visual evidence

Attach sanitized desktop/mobile and light/dark references when relevant. Never use real student data.

## Adoption plan

List consumers, migration order and how duplicate styles/components will be removed.
